info.name: SmartPark - Smart Parking Management API
info.description: Full workflow test of the REST API. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner or `newman run`). Needs the demo data (`python manage.py seed_demo`) for the administrator login. Run against a development or test database: each run creates a new test user and a few bookings.

request.description: Public. New accounts always get the `user` role.

exec: pm.test("returns a token and the new user", () => { pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql('user'); });
pm.test("generic error, no hint which part was wrong", () => { pm.expect(j.non_field_errors[0]).to.eql('Invalid username or password.'); });

request.description: Needs the demo data: `python manage.py seed_demo`.

item.name: List locations that have free slots
List free car slots at that location

exec: pm.test("at least one free car slot", () => { pm.expect(j.count).to.be.above(0); });

request.description: Public. The server computes the charge: hourly rate x hours, rounded up, minimum 1 hour.

exec: pm.test("amount is a 2-decimal string for 2 billed hours", () => { pm.expect(j.amount).to.match(/^\d+\.\d{2}$/); pm.expect(j.billing_blocks).to.eql(2); });

item.name: A malformed id filter is a 400, not a 500
A normal user cannot create a location

body.raw: {"name": "Postman Lot {{run_id}}", "address": "1 Test Road", "city": "Nashik", "description": "Created by the Postman run", "opening_time": "06:00:00", "closing_time": "22:00:00", "hourly_rate": "25.00"}

exec: pm.test("created with no slots yet", () => { pm.expect(j.total_slots).to.eql(0); });
pm.test("slot number is normalised to upper case", () => { pm.expect(j.slot_number).to.eql('PM1'); });

item.name: A duplicate slot number is rejected
Book the slot (starts in 5 minutes, 2 hours)
Booking the same slot and time again is refused
A booking in the past is refused

exec: pm.test("can check in now", () => { pm.expect(j.can_check_in).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.can_check_out).to.eql(false); });

item.name: A vehicle with bookings cannot be deleted

exec: pm.test("a failed attempt is a normal response with status \"failed\"", () => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('failed'); pm.expect(j.amount_paid).to.eql('0.00'); });

item.name: Checking in a completed booking is refused
A normal user cannot see the summary

exec: pm.test("includes the test user's bookings", () => { pm.expect(j.count).to.be.at.least(2); });

item.name: Admin marks the payment as paid (cash)
An invalid payment transition is refused
A normal user cannot change payment status

exec: pm.test("cancelled and the paid amount refunded", () => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('cancelled'); pm.expect(j.payment.status).to.eql('refunded'); });
